package domain

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	// SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded is the owned v1 decision audit event.
	SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded = "teacher.decision.recorded"
	// TeacherDecisionRecordedSchemaVersion is the current payload schema.
	TeacherDecisionRecordedSchemaVersion = 2
	// SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved is the owned learning-action summary event.
	SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved = "teacher.assistance.observed"
	// TeacherAssistanceObservedSchemaVersion is the current payload schema.
	TeacherAssistanceObservedSchemaVersion = 1
)

// EventEnvelope is the versioned wire envelope stored intact in the outbox.
type EventEnvelope struct {
	EventID       string          `json:"event_id"`
	EventType     string          `json:"event_type"`
	CorrelationID string          `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID   string          `json:"causation_id"`
	StudentID     string          `json:"student_id"`
	OccurredAt    time.Time       `json:"occurred_at"`
	SchemaVersion int             `json:"schema_version"`
	Data          json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
}

// IntegrationEvent is a durable, publishable event reconstructed from the outbox.
type IntegrationEvent struct {
	EventID       string
	Subject       string
	CorrelationID string
	CausationID   string
	StudentID     string
	OccurredAt    time.Time
	SchemaVersion int
	Payload       json.RawMessage
	Attempts      int
}

// EventPublisher publishes an outbox event and returns only after broker acknowledgement.
type EventPublisher interface {
	Publish(ctx context.Context, event IntegrationEvent) error
}

// NewIntegrationEvent builds and serializes the canonical envelope.
func NewIntegrationEvent(
	eventID string,
	subject string,
	correlationID string,
	causationID string,
	studentID string,
	occurredAt time.Time,
	schemaVersion int,
	data any,
) (IntegrationEvent, error) {
	eventID = strings.TrimSpace(eventID)
	subject = strings.TrimSpace(subject)
	correlationID = strings.TrimSpace(correlationID)
	causationID = strings.TrimSpace(causationID)
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	occurredAt = occurredAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(eventID) || !validValue(subject, 200) || !validValue(correlationID, 128) ||
		len(causationID) > 128 || !validValue(studentID, 255) || occurredAt.IsZero() || schemaVersion <= 0 {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, errors.New("invalid integration event")
	}
	encodedData, err := json.Marshal(data)
	if err != nil {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, err
	}
	envelope := EventEnvelope{
		EventID:       eventID,
		EventType:     subject,
		CorrelationID: correlationID,
		CausationID:   causationID,
		StudentID:     studentID,
		OccurredAt:    occurredAt,
		SchemaVersion: schemaVersion,
		Data:          encodedData,
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(envelope)
	if err != nil {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, err
	}
	return IntegrationEvent{
		EventID:       eventID,
		Subject:       subject,
		CorrelationID: correlationID,
		CausationID:   causationID,
		StudentID:     studentID,
		OccurredAt:    occurredAt,
		SchemaVersion: schemaVersion,
		Payload:       payload,
	}, nil
}
